findings.description: Changed `self.match.match(...)` to `self.match.fullmatch(...)`, so a regex now has to match the whole exception message instead of just its start. This is a silent behavior change to the public `match` argument.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `retry_if_exception_message(match="timeout")` with an exception message "timeout after 30s". It used to match as a prefix and trigger a retry. Now fullmatch returns None, so the exception is not retried and the caller sees an unexpected failure. Existing users' patterns that rely on prefix matching break.
